title: New Birth by the Spirit
definition: New birth by the Spirit is God's work of giving spiritual life to those who were dead in sin.
summary: The Spirit causes sinners to be born again and made alive to God.
christFocus: Jesus taught that no one can enter the kingdom unless they are born of the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
New birth is not self-improvement or religious enthusiasm. It is the life-giving work of the Holy Spirit. The spiritually dead need to be made alive.

Jesus told Nicodemus that the new birth is necessary. This work is sovereign, gracious, and inward, giving a new heart and new direction.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people mistake outward religion for spiritual life. This doctrine matters because only God can make sinners truly alive.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not settle for outward Christianity. Ask God for true spiritual life, and look for the fruit of new birth in repentance, faith, and love.
